title: CAS upsert product skill draft request
description: Creates revision 1 or replaces one exact current draft revision and hash. Request identity is carried in HTTP attempt headers so a byte-identical idempotent replay may use new attempt IDs.
x-invariants: path session_id and draft_id equal the request fields
base_revision equals 0 if and only if base_draft_sha256 is null and the draft does not exist
for an update, base_revision and base_draft_sha256 both exactly equal the current draft
successful response revision equals base_revision plus 1
session_id, draft_id, skill_id and content_ref cannot change after creation
stale revision or hash returns 409 CONTENT_VERSION_MISMATCH and changes nothing
one idempotency scope is tenant_id plus actor_id plus operationId plus canonical path plus Idempotency-Key
same key and byte-equivalent body replays the original status, resource, Location and ETag; different body returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED
draft mutation and the original idempotency receipt are persisted atomically
